# Together AI — Together AI Startup Accelerator

Tiered program giving up to $15K, $30K or $50K in free Together AI platform credits plus 3, 6 or 10 hours of forward-deployed engineering time, with the tier set by how much the company has raised.

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Build | $15,000 | Up to $5M raised | No partner needed |
| Scale | $30,000 | $5M–$10M raised | No partner needed |
| Grow | $50,000 | Over $10M raised | No partner needed |

### Not covered

- Reserved GPU Clusters
